Printable worksheets

One worksheet for every topic, in three steps. Each one opens as a PDF in a new tab, ready to print or save. Answers are separate, so you can hand out worksheets without them.

YOU DOOn your ownA quick check, a key-terms match and practice questions with answer lines.

Revision checklist

  1. Rate yourself on each “I can” statement. Be honest: tap a rating again to clear it.
  2. Your list builds itself. Any topic you rate red or amber is added. Tap ＋ Add to list on a topic to add it yourself.
  3. Save your list with the button at the bottom: as a picture for your Photos, a file, or copied into Notes or Teams.
